P.note: Front-loads the material and turns 'inside the material' into thickness-graded dye, tinted visible internals and blue caustics in tight natural language, with only minor filler (lens flare, ultra-detailed).

Q.note: Rich Frutiger Aero mood and strong thick-to-thin and overlap logic, but frosted-white silicone cushions replace the vinyl and the scuffs and mold seam undercut the immaculate Y2K gloss.

R.note: Smart hollow-shell color logic and clean positive phrasing, but it is telegraphic and thin, with no lens, mood or Y2K detail to steer it past a generic render.

S.note: Covers the brief most completely (dyed-through gradient, backlit refraction, Y2K inflatable vinyl cushions, every white carrying a cool blue cast); its only flaws are slight filler (HDR, studio-grade clarity) and materials that arrive after the scene.

T.note: Has the most rigorous inside-the-material engineering (highlights over a visible blue body, hollow versus solid gradients), but 'clear neutral daylight' and a 'real lawn' with yellow-green tips pull against the blue-tinted overexposed whites and the electric grass.

U.note: Detailed and well structured, but leading with electric-cyan and #00AEEF pushes the acrylic toward aqua or teal, the cushions become frosted silicone, and 'CGI-saturated' plus a named Bliss landscape invite a derivative look.
